title: buceras corniculata
intro: Buceras corniculata, commonly known as the "Coral Tree" or "Buceras", is a tropical plant species in the family Buceros, native to the Americas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Buceras corniculata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents present in Buceras corniculata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
